messages:
alex: Midday handoff — I'm tapping out at 13:00 PT. Leaving coverage to @marta for the 13-21 shift. Two quick things: small routing config rollout going to canary now, and the prefetch defaults PR merged earlier today. See details below.

deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/cluster-config #432 -> canary on us-west-2-dedicated (2/10 nodes).

marta: taking the shift, ack. Can you paste the PR link and the exact metrics to watch?

alex: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432
Watch: p95 latency for text-gen (api-prod), error rate > 0.3%, and token/sec throughput drop. Canary runs on node-group `dedicated-canary-a`. If p95 > 250ms for >5m, roll back.

sam: adding — watch GPU util on the canary nodes. We sometimes see brief 100% spikes after long sequences.

marta: got it. If rollback is needed what's the quick command?

alex: Quick rollback: `kubectl -n inference set image deployment/routing-proxy routing-proxy=redwood/proxy:stable` then `devops rollback infra/cluster-config #432` (or trigger the deploy bot rollback). Runbook: /runbooks/routing-canary.md

jing: FYI there's an open CR touching KV cache hot-key handling (infra#428). Not part of this deploy but it can increase cold-start p99s. Keep an eye on cold-start latency.

marta: :thumbsup: I'll watch p95/p99 and GPU util, and ping eng-sre if anything odd. Any PRs I should unblock while I'm on shift?

alex: One quick CR ask — please give a fast LGTM on infra#431 (prefetch defaults). Small and related. Otherwise no blockers.

sam: If you need extra eyes I can pull logs and grep for spikes: `grep -E 'latency.*p95|cold-start' /var/log/proxy/*` and attach if something pops.

marta: Action items for this shift:
- monitor p95 (text-gen) and p99 (cold-start)
- check GPU util on canary nodes in us-west-2-dedicated
- be ready to run rollback command / hit deploy bot rollback
- ping eng-sre and #incidents if error rate > 0.3% or sustained p95 > 250ms
I'll post an update at 14:00 PT.

deploy-bot: deploy success: canary 2/2 healthy after 6m. Monitoring window active.

alex: Thanks — left a note in the handoff doc: https://docs.redwood/inference/hand-offs/1767778888. Back on slack if anything urgent tonight.
